entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the order number?

Thank you, Maria. I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on January 6th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not working. That's the issue.
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you describe what's happening? For example, is it not turning on, or is there a specific feature that isn't functioning?
It just won't sync. I've tried everything. It's clearly broken.

Okay, thank you for that detail. It sounds very frustrating when a new device won't sync properly. I see you're on day 11 since receiving it. For an issue like this, where the product might be defective, our process is to connect you with our Technical Support team.
I don't want tech support. I want a refund. The thing is defective.

I completely understand wanting a simple solution. Since the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns, any claim of a defective unit after that point must first be verified by our technical experts. They have the tools to confirm a hardware fault remotely. If they can't fix it, they are authorized to issue a replacement or discuss next steps. Can I transfer you to them?
Fine. Whatever. Just get it over with.
Of course. I've documented the issue for them, so you won't have to repeat yourself. I'm connecting you now. Please stay on the line.
